newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran's Khamenei grants amnesty to 65 female inmates.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Khamenei grants amnesty to 65 female inmates.

text.p: Iran's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei on Saturday upheld an amnesty proposal to pardon or commute sentences of 65 female prisoners, Iran's state-run news ageny IRNA repoterd.
It said Khamenei approved the pardon plan proposed by the chief of the judiciary Ayatollah Mohammed Yazdi to mark the birth anniversary of Fatema, the Moslem Prophet's daughter.
IRNA did not give details of the nature of crimes covered by the amnesty nor a breakdown of pardons and reduced sentences.
